_note: The Standing track, transcribed from the Grognard Sheet's bottom row and
-3(2), -4(1) — a circular 1D10 numbering where the BEST box's '(0)' means
'10', per the booklet's own house rule 'When rolling 1D10, 0 = 10'. Since
this app's dice already normalise a d10 to 1..10 (never a literal 0), the
checkValue for the best box is stored as 10, not 0, so 'Result > (S)' /
'1D10 >= (S)' compare correctly against an actual rolled 1..10 value.
That reindexing also makes 'Roll 1D10 on Standing' trivial: rollToIndex
for roll r is simply index (r-1).
defaultIndex is the '+0 (5)' box: the default for a new or reassigned
Grognard, and (per the Grognard Sheet) the box aligned with the 'Office'
tier — consistent with the booklet's 'Standing: 0 (5) box' at setup.
standingModifier is the signed value used additively in the Battle Event
N/G formula — see the note on StandingBoxSchema in schema.ts.
